description: Ray behavior sliced ray origins instead of angles ([:,:3:] vs [:,3:]); every candidate heading pointed the same direction
evidence_quote: ray-behavior fix on heading all same directions
ruining_rationale: Planner paths all pointed one way regardless of detected rays; observed as a behavior symptom, venue not recorded.

description: Frontier viewpoint PointCloud2 builder appended points outside the for loop, so only the last viewpoint was published
evidence_quote: points.append([x,y,z]) (diff: line re-indented into the for loop; commit message does not mention it)
ruining_rationale: Visualization-only publisher; planning used the viewpoint tensor directly.
fix_loc: 10+/4- (whole commit; also adds top-5 random frontier choice)

description: Ray-vs-cuboid intersection took the smallest positive slab crossing instead of the slab-method entry point, misplacing the approach waypoint
evidence_quote: voxel behavior fix on surface point intersection of cuboid and robot pose ray
ruining_rationale: Approach waypoint could land inside or beside the target cluster; effect on a run depends on geometry.

description: Ray behavior chained targets from every ray group into one path; robot was sent toward all detected directions at once
evidence_quote: fixing ray_behavior to select one direction at a time
ruining_rationale: Path visits every ray-group origin in sequence instead of the best one; degrades but does not abort a run.

description: LVLM behavior averaged ray directions over the wrong tensor axis (torch.mean dim=1 instead of dim=0), giving a wrong guidance direction
evidence_quote: filter out rays behind; LVLM behavior fix
ruining_rationale: Wrong-axis mean yields a malformed direction vector whenever LVLM guidance is active; venue not recorded.

description: VLFM baseline planner called misspelled align_spatiala_features_with_language and a nonexistent mapper attribute; crashed once a target was set
ruining_rationale: Baseline crashes at its first planning step after a prompt; a comparison run restarts rather than silently degrading.

description: ConstructionSite scene launch applied STAGE_SCALE 1.0 to the stage prim; corrected to 0.01 (centimeter stage vs meter drone)
ruining_rationale: Scene rendered 100x too large relative to the drone; visible immediately in the sim viewport.

description: AirStack submodule gitlink was committed without a .gitmodules entry; recursive clone / submodule init of AirStack failed
ruining_rationale: Fails at clone or setup time before any run.

description: .env named the Isaac launch script AbandonedFactory_launch.py; installed files are *_Launch.py, so the isaac tmux pane ran a nonexistent script
ruining_rationale: Isaac Sim fails to start the scene at bring-up; visible in the isaac tmux pane.
fix_loc: 1+/1- (.env; whole commit 7+/1-, fixes multiple listed defects)

description: isaac-sim compose env_file ./omni_pass.env is absent when the Nucleus token step is skipped; container startup errors; README adds a placeholder-file workaround
evidence_quote: If you encounter an error related to a missing `omni_pass.env` file during startup, you can safely create a placeholder file as a workaround
ruining_rationale: Fails at container start before any run; documented workaround, no code fix.

description: RayFronts Docker image lacked scikit-learn while frontier_behavior imports sklearn.cluster.DBSCAN; mapping server failed at import in a fresh container
ruining_rationale: Import error at node start; fails fast.

description: RayFronts subscribed depth on .../front_stereo/left/depth but the Pegasus ZED graph publishes .../left/depth_ground_truth; no depth frames reached the mapper
evidence_quote: modified depth topic for isaac-sim config
ruining_rationale: Silent: no frames reach the mapper, so no map, no frontiers and no plan for the whole session.

description: Simulated Ouster minimum range 0.75 m produced hallucinated obstacles for the local planner; raised to 3.5 m in all four scene scripts
evidence_quote: lidar min range increase to avoid hallucinated obstacles
ruining_rationale: Phantom obstacles perturb avoidance; RAVEN's own March scripts used 4.0 m 'to avoid propeller hits' and the April scene scripts regressed to the AirStack example default 0.75 m.
fix_loc: 14+/12- (4+/4- in the launch scripts; rviz display change in the same commit)

description: Hard-coded 10 deg camera pitch extrinsic from the Spirit drone was still applied to Pegasus Iris poses whose camera has zero tilt; removed
evidence_quote: Previously, we used the Spirit drone and applied a fixed pitch offset because the camera was mounted with a downward tilt. That setup is now deprecated, and Pegasus is used for the code release.
ruining_rationale: Every mapped point is tilted 10 deg about the camera axis; the run continues with a skewed map.

description: input_prompt.py published /input_text while the mapping server had subscribed /input_prompt since 2025-08-22; operator prompts never arrived
ruining_rationale: Silent: with no target received the system stays in frontier-only exploration for the whole session.
fix_loc: 1+/1- (input_prompt.py; whole commit 12+/15- incl. config rename and cleanup)

description: mission_checker drew ground-truth boxes with x/y swapped and negated (x=-center[1], y=center[0]); corrected to direct xyz
ruining_rationale: Affects the RViz ground-truth overlay only.

description: Drone spawn quaternion from launch_raven.sh was not applied: AirStack .env lacked DRONE_* defaults and was sourced after the per-environment pose block

ruining_rationale: Drone spawns with the wrong initial yaw in scenes that need one (FireAcademy); mission start differs from the intended pose.
